subject: Post-call: Buying committee map + outstanding security evidence
summary: Post-demo recap capturing the buying committee, three outstanding security evidence asks (SOC 2 summary, pen-test highlights, retention table), ownership for procurement steps, and a proposed delivery timeline for evidence ahead of Novacorp's internal risk review.
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@novacorp.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lara Bennett <lara.bennett@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — next steps

Connor — thanks for the demo today. Lara and I pulled together the internal list of items risk & procurement need before we can greenlight a pilot. Can you confirm the following ASAP?

1) SOC 2 scope and most recent report (summary is fine)
2) High-level pen-test results / whether you allow customer review of findings or redacted summary
3) Data retention options and a mapping for logs/audit retention (how long do you keep request logs, KV cache, user-provided files if any)

Also, procurement asked about the PO process and whether Redwood will accept a vendor agreement with Novacorp's standard SOW — if not, who on your side owns contracting?

Appreciate a short bulleted reply and any docs we can share with our security team.

— Sanjay
From: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@novacorp.com>, Lara Bennett <lara.bennett@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — next steps

Thanks Sanjay — quick recap and ownership so theres a single source of truth: 

- SOC 2: Marissa will send a 1-page SOC 2 summary (scope + date + auditor) and a redacted control matrix. Expect that by EOD tomorrow (Nov 17). Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary-v1.pdf
- Pen test: We have a recent third-party audit. Im attaching a pen-test highlights doc (redacted) and Marissa can coordinate a secure review with your security team if needed. Attachment: pen-test-highlights.pdf
- Data retention: see attached CSV for retention defaults and configurable options. Short answers: request logs = 13 months by default, KV cache is ephemeral (session-based, configurable), customer files depend on deployment (hosted vs private). Attachment: data-retention-matrix.csv
- Procurement / contracting: Ben owns procurement on our side. Hell outline the PO flow and confirm whether we can accept your standard SOW or need a redline.

Next steps (proposal):
- Nov 17: Marissa sends SOC2 + evidence checklist
- Nov 18: Ben sends short procurement summary + PO path and contract owner
- Nov 19–23: Technical & security sync (we can host a secure intake call with your SecOps)

Ill include an evidence checklist in the next email so you can hand it to risk.

If that timeline looks good, Ill lock calendar invites.

Thanks,
Connor Obrien
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@novacorp.com>, Lara Bennett <lara.bennett@novacorp.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 summary + evidence checklist (Novacorp)

Hi Sanjay / Lara — attaching the items Connor mentioned and a simple evidence checklist to make handoff to risk easier. Quick notes: 

- redwood-soc2-summary-v1.pdf: one-page cover (scope, auditor, date) + redacted SOC2 report index.
- evidence-delivery-checklist.xlsx: row per ask with owner and preferred delivery channel (Drive link or secure SFTP).
- pen-test-highlights.pdf: redacted highlights; full report requires an NDA and secure transfer.
- data-retention-matrix.csv: mapping for request logs, KV cache, and artifact retention by deployment type.

Open items:
- Confirm whether Novacorp requires full pen-test report or a redacted executive summary (we can do either; full report needs NDA).
- Decide preferred secure transfer (Drive folder or SFTP).

Attaching files to this thread and uploading to the Drive folder (link below). If you want a one-hour secure intake call with our security lead + Marissa, we can schedule for next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-v1.pdf, evidence-delivery-checklist.xlsx, pen-test-highlights.pdf, data-retention-matrix.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@novacorp.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lara Bennett <lara.bennett@novacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement steps & PO flow for Novacorp

Sanjay — quick note on procurement:

- We can accept a PO for the pilot; standard process is 30-day net payment after invoice.
- For enterprise contracts, we typically review customer SOWs; small redlines are fine. If there are material legal terms, our Legal team will need to review (turnaround 5–7 business days).
- To keep things moving, please share your procurement contact and a sample SOW or PO template. Ill validate and confirm whether Legal needs to engage.

Action owners:
- Nov 18: Ben to confirm PO path and provide template/next steps (in separate email if needed)
- Nov 23: Marissa & Security intake call (confirm time)

Thanks — Ben
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@novacorp.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lara Bennett <lara.bennett@novacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Buying committee map + outstanding security evidence

Perfect — thanks for the fast turnaround. A couple of clarifications: 

- We only need a redacted pen-test executive summary today (full report will be requested later and we can provide an NDA).
- Drive folder is fine for the SOC2/summary and checklist; for the pen-test full report later well request SFTP.
- Procurement contact is me (Ill route the PO). Ill send the PO template by EOD Nov 19.

Please go ahead and upload the documents to the Drive link you listed and Ill circulate to risk. After I get the PO template Ill confirm the kickoff date for the pilot.

— Sanjay
